about.title: About Desanara
about.metaDescription: Desanara is a catalogue of small businesses from partner villages in West Java. Orders go straight to the maker's WhatsApp, with no commission.

hero.title: Ragam Karya, Cerita Nusantara.
hero.lead: Desanara is a catalogue of products made by small businesses in partner villages. Every product carries the name of its village, and every order goes straight to the maker on WhatsApp.
hero.facts: <biz>{businesses}</biz> businesses from <vil>{villages}</vil> partner villages in Bandung, Garut and Sumedang regencies.

problem.title: Villages make plenty. Finding it is the hard part.

hidden.body: Many village businesses make good products, yet their buyers rarely reach beyond neighbours and friends.

scattered.body: People looking for souvenirs or a village's speciality have no obvious place to start.

unready.body: Clear photos, descriptions and prices are often missing, and those are what give a buyer confidence.

problem.answer: Desanara answers with two things: <hl>one catalogue that brings many villages together</hl>, and <hl>students who work with each business</hl> to prepare its page.

order.lead: Choose a quantity and add a note. Desanara writes the order, then the seller's WhatsApp opens with the message ready to send. Try changing the order below.
order.languageNote: The message is always written in Indonesian, so the seller can read it easily.
order.after: Payment and delivery are agreed directly with the seller. Desanara takes nothing from the sale.
order.step3: Ready to send to the seller

roles.lead: Everyone looks after their own part, and it all comes together on the same pages.

buyer.title: Find a product and talk to the person who made it.

steps.1: Search for a product, or open a village page to see all of its businesses.
steps.2: See photos, prices, and whether the shop is open, worked out from its opening hours.
steps.3: Tap Order via WhatsApp. No account needed.

owner.title: A business page that carries the village's name.

steps.1: The business story, products and online shop links sit on one page.
steps.2: Orders arrive straight on WhatsApp, with no commission.
steps.3: An assistant helps fill in the details until the page is ready.

assistant.title: Students who help businesses get online.

steps.1: Register a business through a four-step form, right from a phone.
steps.2: Entries are saved automatically, even when the signal drops.
steps.3: Upload up to ten photos per product. Photos are compressed and their location data removed.

admin.title: The village confirms that every business is real.

steps.1: Review new businesses in the To check list.
steps.2: Approve, or reject with a reason the assistant can read.
steps.3: Take down a business when there is a problem, with the reason recorded.

hima.title: Running the platform and its partner villages.

steps.1: Verify villages that want to join by phone, visit and a partnership agreement.
steps.2: Activate villages and manage product categories.
steps.3: Support villages and businesses through seminars and training.

trust.lead: A new business appears only after three steps. Nobody can skip the village check.

submitted.title: Registered
submitted.body: An assistant or the owner enters the business details, WhatsApp number and the owner's consent.

checked.title: Checked by the village
checked.body: The village admin confirms the business really exists in the village and the details are right.

live.title: Published
live.body: The business appears on Desanara with the verified-by-village badge.

address.title: Addresses stay private
address.body: Home addresses, neighbourhood numbers and map pins are never shown. Public locations stop at the village.

schedule.title: Honest opening status
schedule.body: Open and closed are worked out from the weekly schedule, so the status stays right even when owners forget to update it.

commission.title: No commission
commission.body: Desanara takes no cut and never handles the payment.

consent.title: With the owner's consent
consent.body: A business is published only with its owner's consent, as Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law requires.

baros.body: Desa Baros, in Arjasari district, Bandung Regency, is Desanara's first village. Its businesses range from crafts and fashion to processed food.
baros.photoAlt: The bamboo tourism area in Desa Baros
baros.crestLabel: Crest of the Desa Baros village government
baros.direction: The village has a clear aim: <hl>sell processed goods, not raw crops</hl>. Hanjeli, for example, becomes rengginang crackers, tape and baby porridge flour.
baros.others: Now joined by {count} more villages in <bandung>Bandung</bandung>, <garut>Garut</garut> and <sumedang>Sumedang</sumedang> regencies.

survey.title: Desa Baros survey
survey.body: The HIMASIF team met village officials and the business coordinator to understand what they needed.

launch.title: Desanara goes live
launch.body: The catalogue, village pages and dashboards for villages, assistants and businesses launched at desanara.app.

seminar.title: Seminar and showcase at the Desa Baros village office
seminar.body: Business owners learn to use digital opportunities, then get help building their business pages. The goal is 30 to 60 businesses online.

expand.title: More villages
expand.body: Village page templates, a cart sent to WhatsApp in one go, a mobile app, and self-service sign-up for villages.

transact.title: Payments on the platform
transact.body: Payment and shipping inside Desanara, once a legal entity is in place to run them.

makers.body: Desanara is a community service programme of HIMA Sistem Informasi, SATU University. Students build the platform, then go to the villages to work with the businesses in person.
makers.partnerBody: Village governments, universities, communities and companies that want to support village businesses can reach out to work with us.

free.a: Yes. Buyers pay nothing to browse, and businesses pay nothing to be listed.

commission.q: Does Desanara take a cut of each sale?
commission.a: No. Orders go straight to the seller's WhatsApp, and payment never passes through Desanara.

payment.q: How do payment and delivery work?
payment.a: You agree on payment and delivery with the seller on WhatsApp. Some businesses also list their online shops.

account.a: No. Pick a product and tap Order via WhatsApp.

village.a: Contact the HIMASIF team on Instagram. The team verifies the village by phone and a visit, agrees a partnership, then activates the village page.

privacy.a: Street addresses, neighbourhood numbers, map pins and business registration numbers are visible only to the village team and the business's assistant. Only details the owner has agreed to share are public.

language.a: Indonesian and English. Product names and descriptions appear in English when the business has added a translation.

join.sellerBody: Online sign-up is on its way. For now, contact your village admin or the HIMASIF team on Instagram.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: What data Desanara collects, what is shown publicly, and the rights business owners have over their data.
privacy.intro: Desanara connects buyers with village businesses. This page explains what data we collect, why, who can see it, and how you can control it. We follow Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (Law No. 27 of 2022).

sections.title: Who manages the data
body: Desanara is run by HIMA Sistem Informasi, SATU University, as a community service programme. We are responsible for the data collected through the Desanara website and dashboard.

sections.title: Data we collect
body: What we store depends on how you use Desanara.
items: Visitors and buyers do not need an account. We count page views and WhatsApp button taps for statistics, <hl>without storing IP addresses, device details or tracking cookies</hl>.
Your language choice and the business stories you have seen are kept on your own device, not on our servers.

For each business: business name, owner name, story, products and their photos, WhatsApp number, online shop links, street address, neighbourhood numbers (RT/RW), map pin, and business registration number (NIB) if provided.
For dashboard users (village admins, assistants and business owners): name, email address, and a password stored as a hash.

sections.title: What is shown publicly
items: Shown after the owner agrees: business name, owner name, story, products, WhatsApp number and online shop links.
Always shown: village, district and regency.
Never shown publicly: <hl>street address, RT/RW, map pin and NIB</hl>. Only the village team and the business's assistant can see them.
Account emails and passwords are never shown.

sections.title: Business owner consent
body: A business is published only after its owner agrees to its data being shown. The assistant reads out what will be public, and the owner signs a consent form. The time and method of consent are recorded.
<hl>Owners can withdraw consent at any time</hl>. Once withdrawn, the business page is hidden from the public straight away.

sections.title: How we use data
items: To show the product catalogue and business pages.
To connect buyers with sellers on WhatsApp.
To confirm each business is real, through verification by its village admin.
To count page views and WhatsApp taps as impact reports for villages and businesses.
To keep accounts secure, for example by emailing verification codes.
note: <hl>We do not sell data and do not use it for advertising</hl>.

sections.title: Orders through WhatsApp
body: When you tap Order via WhatsApp, the WhatsApp app on your device opens with the message filled in. The conversation and payment happen directly between you and the seller. Desanara does not read, store or take part in that conversation. Your use of WhatsApp follows WhatsApp's own privacy policy.

sections.title: Where data is stored
body: Data is stored with third-party services we use to run Desanara: Vercel for the website, Supabase (PostgreSQL) for the database in the Singapore region, Cloudflare R2 for photos, and Resend for sending email. Data is used only to run Desanara.
Before upload, every photo is processed on the device so that location (GPS) information inside it is removed.

sections.title: Security
items: Each dashboard user can only see and change data for the village or business they belong to.
Accounts are created by invitation, and the email address must be verified before signing in.
Every important change is recorded: who made it, what changed and when.

sections.title: Your rights
body: Business owners may see their data, ask for corrections, withdraw consent and ask for their data to be deleted. Send requests through your assistant, your village admin or the HIMASIF team, and we will handle them as soon as we can.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: This policy may be updated as Desanara grows. The effective date at the top of the page will change with it.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.description: The rules for using Desanara as a buyer, a business or a partner village.
terms.intro: By using the Desanara website and dashboard, you agree to the terms below. We have kept them as plain as we can.

sections.title: About the service
body: Desanara is a catalogue of products from businesses in partner villages, run by HIMA Sistem Informasi, SATU University. <hl>Desanara is not a shop and does not take payments</hl>. Orders happen directly between buyer and seller on WhatsApp.

sections.title: For buyers
items: Price, availability, product quality, payment and delivery are agreed directly with the seller.
Desanara is not a party to the transaction, so confirm the order details before paying.
A shop's open or closed status is worked out from the schedule the seller entered and may differ from the actual situation.

sections.title: For businesses
items: Business and product details must be accurate and belong to your own business.
Uploaded photos must be your own or used with the owner's permission.
A business appears after it is verified by the village admin and approved by its owner.
Being listed on Desanara is free, and <hl>there is no commission on sales</hl>.

sections.title: The role of villages and the HIMA team
body: Village admins verify the businesses in their village and can take down a business when there is a problem, with the reason recorded. The HIMA team runs the platform, activates partner villages and supports villages and businesses.

sections.title: What is not allowed
items: Offering products that are illegal or dangerous.
Giving false information or misleading buyers.
Using other people's photos, brands or work without permission.
Posting content that is insulting or divisive.
note: Content that breaks these rules can be hidden or removed by the village admin or the HIMA team.

sections.title: Content and brands
body: Stories, products and photos remain the business's own. By publishing them, the owner allows Desanara to show them on the site and in Desanara's introductory materials. The Desanara, HIMASIF and SATU University names and logos, and village crests, belong to their respective owners.

sections.title: Limits of liability
body: Desanara is provided as is. We work to keep the site running and its data accurate, but we are not responsible for transactions, losses or disputes between buyers and sellers.

sections.title: Changes to the service and terms
body: Features and these terms may change as Desanara grows. The effective date at the top of the page will change with them. These terms are governed by the laws of Indonesia.
